name: Edna Valley

climate: Seasons this warm ripen Chardonnay, Merlot, Syrah, Cabernet Sauvignon and Sauvignon Blanc fully without cooking off their freshness.
Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Chardonnay and Syrah sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.
Summers are close to rainless. Vines need irrigation or deep soil that stores winter rain, but disease is rare.

soil.rock: Shale and mudstone are fine-grained rocks that hold heat well and are moderately fertile.
soil.top: The topsoil holds water well and drains at a steady pace, so vines rarely go thirsty or sit in wet ground. Its pH is close to neutral, so vines take up the nutrients they need easily.

land: Gentle slopes. Enough tilt to drain cold air and rain away, which lowers frost risk, yet still easy to farm by machine.

winkler: Early and mid-season grapes make good wine.
